contexts.text: That which is exterior is also lower.
Outer darkness = the more direful Falsities of those who are in the Church. AC 7688, Explained.
His arms and feet = the exteriors of the Word, which are the sense of the letter.
Exterior things cannot enter into interior ones...
Exterior Knowledges. Signified, Explained.
A valley = lower things, or, what is the same, exterior things.
To pass to lower or exterior truths. Signified, Explained.
Doctrine is predicated of exterior things...
The exterior goods and truths which are of the natural man. Signified.
Exterior things are composite.
He then regards exterior things as one does a tempestuous sea from a high hill.
They who are only in exterior things are relatively in a mist.
The more exterior the perception is, the more obscure it is; for exterior things are relatively general ones; for innumerable interior things appear as one in what is exterior.
Exterior things are signified by those which are less noble. The reason is, that in themselves, exterior things are grosser than interior ones; for they are generals...
As to exterior things. Signified.
The reason a Nazarite = exterior things, is...
The more exteriorly a man thinks, the less extension he has. Explained.
Can be amended only as to the exteriors.
Exterior goods. Signified. Exterior goods are those which are in the Natural, and are commonly called delights.
The exterior good and also the exterior evil which are signified by beast, is that which is of the thought, and when nothing stands in the way, of the action. Explained.
The exterior Angels of the Spiritual Kingdom. Explained, Signified.
In the other life the exteriors are successively unfolded...
A garment, in general... = that which is relatively exterior.
Towards the exteriors of that Heaven, where truths are in obscurity. Signified.
The things which proceed towards the exteriors are less perfect according to the degree of the removal from the inmosts...
The ordination of exterior things under interior and inmost ones. Signified.
The horns of the altar = the exterior things (of worship).
The first state of man after death is that of his exteriors. General article.

As the exteriors belong to the body also, they are separated after death; and the things from them which adhere to the spirit are lulled to sleep, so that they only serve as a plane for interior things...
They are remitted by short alternations into the state of their exteriors... Some are indignant that they are not allowed to be continually in the state of their exteriors...
That thus the outside may be clean also () = that thus the exteriors, which are the works and speech, are purified...
Their exteriors are like the exteriors of those who live a Christian life...
